title: Geophone position nahi, sirf velocity pakadta hai 🌍 #shorts
description:
Geophone mein koi chip nahi hai, sirf ek coil aur magnet! Phir bhi ye zameen ki halchal pakad leta hai.
Dekho coil kaise voltage banata hai aur kyun ye velocity follow karta hai.
🌍 Coil spring pe latki, magnet ke charon taraf
⚡ Output analog hai: 28.8 V/m/s
📈 1 mm/s par lagbhag 28.8 mV
🔧 Arduino Due pe JP3 jumper 3.3 V mode mein
Subscribe karo Echo Lab 3D aur roz ek sensor kholke dekho!
